cdd.glance.sub.en: The people who first opened a series in this period, as the filters above narrow them. Every share is of the people who saw the page.
cdd.glance.sub.zh: 这段时间内首次打开剧集的人（按上面的筛选）。所有百分比都以看到页面的人为基数。

cdd.path.sub.en: Each step's people, as a share of those who saw the page, and how many of the step before went on to it.
cdd.path.sub.zh: 每一步的人数、占看到页面者的比例，以及上一步中有多少人继续到这一步。

cdd.path.ep1_25.zh: 第 1 集看了四分之一

cdd.path.ep1_75.zh: 第 1 集看了四分之三

cdd.before.sub.en: What happened to the people who never had a video playing, and how long the page and the first frame took. Timing is recorded since Sep 25, 2026.
cdd.before.sub.zh: 从未播放视频的人发生了什么，以及页面和第一帧用了多长时间。时间自 2026 年 9 月 25 日起记录。

cdd.before.unseenSub.en: TikTok loaded it out of sight, or it went out of sight within a second of the player appearing. Not counted as having seen the page.
cdd.before.unseenSub.zh: TikTok 在后台加载了页面，或播放器出现后一秒内页面就被隐藏。不算作看到页面。

cdd.before.noEventsSub.en: Mostly TikTok's iPhone browser before Sep 24, 6 pm, which lost our records.
cdd.before.noEventsSub.zh: 主要是 9 月 24 日下午 6 点之前 TikTok 的 iPhone 浏览器，记录丢失。

cdd.before.never.en: Saw the page, no video ever played
cdd.before.never.zh: 看到页面，但视频从未播放

cdd.before.leftSub.en: They waited {wait} on average before leaving.

cdd.before.restarted.en: The phone stopped the video, the player started it again
cdd.before.restarted.zh: 手机停止了视频，播放器重新开始播放

cdd.before.restartedSub.en: {muted} of them went on muted with Tap for sound (sound is what the phone stopped). Since Sep 25.
cdd.before.restartedSub.zh: 其中 {muted} 人改为静音继续播放并显示“点按开启声音”（手机停止的是声音）。自 9 月 25 日起。

cdd.before.blockedSub.en: The phone refused sound before a tap: the episode played muted with Tap for sound.
cdd.before.blockedSub.zh: 手机在点按之前不允许声音：该集以静音播放并显示“点按开启声音”。

cdd.hist.load.en: From the tap to the player on screen

cdd.hist.start.en: From the tap to the first video frame

cdd.hist.wait.en: How long people waited before leaving with no video yet
cdd.hist.wait.zh: 在还没有视频时，人们等待多久后离开

cdd.hist.summary.en: {n} measured · half within {median} · three quarters within {p75} · {over5} over 5 s
cdd.hist.summary.zh: 共 {n} 人 · 一半在 {median} 内 · 四分之三在 {p75} 内 · {over5} 超过 5 秒

cdd.hist.none.en: Nothing recorded yet for these filters (recorded since Sep 25, 2026).
cdd.hist.none.zh: 这些筛选条件下还没有记录（自 2026 年 9 月 25 日起记录）。

cdd.phone.sub.en: The same people by the phone and browser they landed with (the other filters apply). Pick one to narrow the whole page to it.
cdd.phone.sub.zh: 按落地时使用的手机和浏览器区分（其他筛选仍然生效）。选择一种即可将整页缩小到它。

cdd.series.sub.en: Every series for these people (the other filters apply). The title opens its own page: episode 1 minute by minute, every episode, the unlock screen.
cdd.series.sub.zh: 这些人的每部剧（其他筛选仍然生效）。点击标题打开它自己的页面：第 1 集的逐分钟数据、每一集、解锁页。

cdd.ads.byPhoneNote.en: Spend is per ad, not per phone, so the costs are hidden while a phone is picked; pick All phones to see them.
cdd.ads.byPhoneNote.zh: 花费是按广告计算的，不按手机，所以选择手机时不显示成本；选择“全部手机”即可查看。

cdd.why.sub.en: The player's two one-tap questions (asked since Sep 25), for these people.
cdd.why.sub.zh: 播放器里的两个一键问题（9 月 25 日起询问），针对这些人。

cdd.site.audience.zh: 观众（全站，不受筛选影响）

cdd.site.money.zh: 收入（全站，不受筛选影响）

cdd.out.sub.en: Visits left out of every number above, in this period (the whole site).
cdd.out.sub.zh: 这段时间内（全站）没有计入上面任何数字的访问。

cdd.out.robotsNote.en: Over the last 120 days: {crawler} crawlers, {burst} that saw many locked episodes at once, {end} that jumped to the last episode, {link} TikTok checking the ad link.
cdd.out.robotsNote.zh: 过去 120 天：{crawler} 个爬虫，{burst} 个同时看到很多锁定集，{end} 个直接跳到最后一集，{link} 个是 TikTok 在检查广告链接。

cdd.out.unseenNote.en: Browsers whose page TikTok loaded out of sight, or that went out of sight within a second.
cdd.out.unseenNote.zh: 页面被 TikTok 在后台加载，或一秒内就被隐藏的浏览器。

cdd.out.browsedNote.en: Saw a series in the feed or on its series page and never opened it.
cdd.out.browsedNote.zh: 在推荐流或剧集页上看到了剧集，但从未打开。

cdd.defs.unseen.en: Never on screen: the page loaded but nobody saw it: TikTok's app loads an ad's page out of sight, and on iPhones takes it out of sight within a second of the player appearing. These are left out of “Saw the page” and every step after it.
cdd.defs.unseen.zh: 从未显示：页面加载了但没人看到：TikTok 的应用会在后台加载广告页面，在 iPhone 上还会在播放器出现一秒内将页面隐藏。这些不计入“看到页面”及之后的每一步。

cdd.defs.opened.en: Saw the page: opened the series' watch page and saw it. Seeing a series only in the feed or on its series page is “only browsed”, not counted.
cdd.defs.opened.zh: 看到页面：打开并看到了剧集的播放页。只在推荐流或剧集页上看到剧集属于“只是浏览”，不计入。

cdd.defs.timing.en: Timing counts from the tap on the ad (or link) that opened the page. Recorded since Sep 25, 2026.
cdd.defs.timing.zh: 时间从打开页面的广告（或链接）被点按时算起。自 2026 年 9 月 25 日起记录。

cdd.place.sub.en: The same people by where their phone was when they watched: the country, then the state once you pick a country (the other filters apply). Recorded since Sep 25, 2026, from the phone's internet address; earlier visits show as Not recorded.
cdd.place.sub.zh: 按观看时手机所在的位置区分：国家/地区，选择国家后按州（其他筛选仍然生效）。自 2026 年 9 月 25 日起根据手机的网络地址记录；更早的访问显示为“未记录”。
